Design for intelligent eyewear

Intelligent eyewear is designed for all-day wear, providing convenient, hands-free access to information. Design intelligent, augmented experiences that enhance a user's focus and presence in the real world. Extend your app to audio and display glasses with design guidance and UI kits. Foundations guide

Get started

Guides

Principles

Fundamental concepts and principles to get started designing for audio and display glasses. Go to foundations Guides

Surfaces

What are the different design context touchpoints, these can include home, system ui, and your app view. Go to guidance Guides

Interactions & Patterns

Interaction patterns that help your users understand, interact with, and control their experience in your app. Common patterns include audio patterns, gestures, and feedback. Go to guidance Guides

Styles

Learn about Jetpack Compose Glimmer's design language, a simplified theme for optimal visibility on glasses. Go to style

Bring augmented experiences to your users

Intelligent eyewear extends the reach of Android apps into a new, highly personal form factor. Apps designed for audio and display glasses should enrich daily life, providing hands-free utility and discreet access to digital services.

World sensing

Respond to user's real-world context

Faster comprehension

Provide visuals in context

Visual assistance

Give your users superpowers

Hands-free capture

Users can stay in the moment

Explore intelligent eyewear

Audio Glasses

Use AI agents for hands-free, natural language interactions, offering proactive and reactive audio guidance for tasks like media control and navigation. Design for concise audio responses and text to speech. On audio glasses, the same app states can trigger different outputs like text-to-speech.

Display Glasses

With a display, combine audio with subtle, glanceable visuals. These high-contrast, minimal visuals provide information like navigation or notifications, appearing only when relevant to enhance, not obstruct, the user's view. You can create your app on display glasses with unique interactions for the display.
